description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over the course of training for five different models—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—on a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis, labeled "Step," represents the number of training steps, ranging from 0k to 440k, with major tick marks at intervals of 20k. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," measures the loss value on a scale from 0.0 to 0.85. All five models begin with a high training loss, with the ChemBART Small 20M (red line) starting at approximately 0.8, followed by the ChemBART Medium 20M (blue line) at around 0.78, and the other models starting slightly lower. All models exhibit a rapid initial decrease in loss, with the ChemBART Small 20M and ChemBART Medium 20M lines showing a steeper decline than the others. After approximately 20k steps, the loss for all models stabilizes, converging to a range between 0.1 and 0.2. The ChemBERTa Medium 20M (green line) and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown line) show the lowest final loss values, hovering around 0.1, while the ChemBART Small 20M (red line) and ChemBART Medium 20M (blue line) remain slightly higher, around 0.15. The ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple line) follows a similar trajectory to the other models, ending with a loss slightly above 0.1. The plot includes a zoomed-in view of the final 20k steps, highlighting the convergence of all models to a stable loss value.
